## 席位核对
ACCEPT — PR #36571 @ `1a95ac7a8fc655831505f1a16d361c3716403236` · card #36408 · L1 read by area s2-D itself (seat area order item 9), at 2026-11-23T00:07Z

- Shape: draft → `main`; first line `Fixes #36408` (search, sort, grouping and Filter panel kept in the address, pinned through open/close and reload); no closing keyword on another card; `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` in body and changeset (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36571`: CLEAN).
- Premise: #36299's report 7077650228 measured the lost search; origin/main `87c7bbaf` `ObjectDataPage.tsx` never called the list-state readers. The design point is landed as the claim 7086904833 settled it: `filter[...]` stays the page's own conditions (tags, 「Reset」 to source, "Save as view"), the Filter panel is `uf__filter` on top, ListView ANDs the two, neither rewrites the other; the dev measured no conflicting case.
- Diff read (3 files, +379/−7): `ObjectDataPage` reuses `parseListStateParams` / `applyListStateParams` from `userFilterUrlState.ts` (unchanged, as is `objectViewListUrlState.ts`, which PR #36411 edits), seeds the list once per object and list generation through ObjectView's field gate (undeclared or unreadable fields dropped; a panel filter losing any condition is refused whole with ObjectView's notice), writes the seed back with replace, and writes every list change with replace (no history entry per keystroke). 「Reset」 to source now also remounts the list on an empty seed, so it stops searching by a term the address lost; the dev caught and fixed a write-back that restored a removed `filter[status]`, pinned by the Reset case. The L567 comment's intent (#2251: never write back to a saved view) holds and is reworded.
- Tests: 7 new cases as a top-level describe in the shared harness `ObjectDataPage.openRule-35875.test.tsx` (the card's search → open → close case, reload with both layers, grouping restore, CONTROL with no list state, refused panel filter, Reset, cleared sort leaves the address); 89 existing cases unchanged and green. Ablation of the search write ⇒ the card's case red, restored blob == HEAD.
- Gates: check-runs at `1a95ac7a`: 39 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed (`pr-state.mjs --pr 36571`); 38 derived families reconciled 0 NOT-MEASURED (`/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36408-gates-ran.txt`); `overlap-check` clean.
- Accepted deviation: a reload is not a reset here, unlike ObjectView, because the card's acceptance asks state to survive a reload and this page has no view to return to.
- Out of scope, not filed (both in the PR's Acceptance notes): the refused-panel notice reuses ObjectView's wording, which says "the view"; and, read from code only and unchanged by this PR, moving straight from one object's /data to another's does not remount the page or the list, so the once-read seed is not re-read from the new address.
- Landing: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 36571` ⇒ NOT governed, 386 lines ≤ 3000; no contract face ⇒ no L2 owed; K = 4, no display label changed ⇒ area lands it.
